title.value: Predicting the probability distribution of bus travel time to measure the reliability of public transport services
title.justification: The title clearly states the focus of the paper on predicting travel time distribution for buses to assess public transport reliability.
title.quote: Predicting the probability distribution of bus travel time to measure the reliability of public transport services

extractions.description: The paper examines predictive models for estimating the probability distribution of bus travel times to improve reliability in public transport services. It highlights the use of probabilistic models to predict the conditional probability density function of travel times, with a focus on reducing expected secondary delays to enhance service reliability.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The focus on public transport reliability directly contributes to sustainable transportation systems, a key aspect of Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: An important aspect of the quality of a public transport service is its reliability, which is defined as the invariability of the service attributes.

primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on improving public transport reliability addresses issues of urban transportation efficiency, which is crucial for reducing emissions and promoting sustainable transport systems.
primary_category.quote: In order to increase ridership and attract new users, public transport agencies put increasing emphasis on improving the quality of the service they provide and particularly its regularity, also referred to as reliability.

secondary_categories.justification: Improving public transport reliability can also be seen as an adaptation measure to reduce urban congestion and increase urban resilience to transportation disruptions.
secondary_categories.quote: Reliability can be addressed at different levels, either during the strategic planning, the tactical planning, or the operational planning and during operations.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically deals with public transport, including bus schedules and reliability, fitting under the Transportation category for Climate Change Mitigation.
primary_sub_category.quote: The network design, the frequencies and/or timetables of buses, the vehicle schedules, and the crew schedules are built during these stages, among other things.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Although not directly addressed, ensuring reliable public transport can help cities adapt to various climate risks by providing dependable mobility services under changing conditions.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: At the strategic planning level, adding reserved lanes for buses can increase the reliability of the service.

applications.justification: While not explicitly about autonomous buses, improving public transport systems aligns with advancements towards more autonomous and efficient public transportation solutions.
applications.quote: In order to increase ridership and attract new users, public transport agencies put increasing emphasis on improving the quality of the service they provide and particularly its regularity, also referred to as reliability.
